settings.max_tokens_applies_to: each reply; in the tool track each turn, up to 8 turns

adjudication.adjudicator: Claude (the lead AI agent), not a human; a human spot-check is still owed

catch_by_type.note: pooled = share of all replies to corrupted notes of that type that were caught (adjudicated); model_mean = average of the per-model rates

comparisons.a: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with the engine

headline: Given client notes with one planted error, three of five cheap open-weight models answered confidently 81–93% of the time and caught 1–3%. The best models caught 73–80% with almost no false alarms. With the planning engine as a tool, a cheap model went from 29% to 79% on hard questions.
